SHA-256: 39b5be7e8c60262b97faad4d9769e875bccbafce3dd1a28e1ab8002fe36dd50e

# Phase C2 Feng split-control post-hoc robustness audit

## Status

Frozen on 2026-10-22 after the original Feng result was known and before any
split-control outcome was computed. This is a post-hoc robustness audit, not a
new confirmatory experiment.

## Question

The original 32-anchor/68-test design separated perturbation tasks, but anchor
and test effects were constructed from the same batch-specific concurrent
control pools. The audit asks whether the held-out improvement persists when
the control cells used to fit alpha are disjoint from those used for scoring.

## Frozen design

- Split the control cells separately within each of the 72 batches.
- Rank cells deterministically by SHA-256 of the fixed seed, repeat, batch, and
  canonical cell ID.
- Assign `floor(n/2)` cells to A and all remaining cells to B; both halves must
  be non-empty.
- Run 100 repetitions. In every repetition evaluate both directions:
  A-controls for anchor fitting and B-controls for test scoring, then the
  reverse.
- Average the two direction-specific macro MSE values before computing the
  symmetrized relative reduction.
- Keep the target cells, 32/68 task split, 6,639 genes, source predictions,
  and one-parameter bounded alpha estimator unchanged.

## Interpretation fixed before outcomes

- `ROBUST_POSITIVE`: the 10th percentile across the 100 symmetrized splits is
  above zero versus both zero and the uncalibrated shrinker.
- `POSITIVE_BUT_SPLIT_SENSITIVE`: both medians are positive, but at least one
  10th percentile is not positive.
- `NOT_SUPPORTED`: either median is not positive.

The split percentile range is a partition-stability range, not a confidence
interval. Repeated splits are not independent screens, and no p-value will be
used to claim screen-level generalization. The original 2% Gate E threshold is
reported descriptively but does not define this post-hoc audit.

## Known limitation

There are 605 controls across 72 batches (median 8, range 2–15). Half-control
pseudobulks are therefore noisier than the original full-control estimates.
The audit reports the complete split distribution rather than choosing a
favorable seed.

# Phase C KOLF exploratory failure diagnostics

This is a post-hoc exploratory analysis. Gate D remains `inconclusive`; no task was deleted and no model was refit.

- Held-out tasks analyzed: 452
- Tasks beating zero: 313 (69.25%)
- Macro MSE improvement versus zero: 0.691%
- Global alpha: 0.17122154
- Positive-loss / winning-gain ratio: 0.2014

## Loss concentration

- top 01 percent (5 tasks) accounts for 26.91% of total positive loss.
- top 05 percent (23 tasks) accounts for 68.95% of total positive loss.
- top 10 percent (46 tasks) accounts for 87.67% of total positive loss.

## Strongest rank associations with regret versus zero

- `cosine_target_vs_prediction`: Spearman -0.9082
- `task_optimal_alpha_unbounded`: Spearman -0.8777
- `consensus`: Spearman -0.2885
- `uncalibrated_prediction_norm`: Spearman -0.2098
- `target_effect_norm`: Spearman -0.1611
- `target_rows`: Spearman 0.0349

## Interpretation boundary

These patterns may generate hypotheses only. Any selector, alternative alpha, feature weighting, or abstention rule derived here must be frozen and tested on a new independent screen; this KOLF test set cannot validate it.

SHA-256: 0c7174c6246256998bfcd2ed82abbcb7735ccb2c7a33343d197b8c52af641cb7

# Phase C KOLF minimal target-anchor protocol freeze

- Status: `frozen_after_b2_aggregate_gate_review_before_phase_c_partition_evaluation`
- Frozen on: `2026-10-20`
- Based on B2 result commit: `1f936a40eedcc95409b78e47b511a78b37a03233`
- B2 aggregate gates were reviewed to authorize Phase C; task-level outcomes were not used for partition selection.
- Partition: 32 anchor / 452 held-out test tasks.
- Allocation: four equal-count target-row strata; eight deterministic SHA-256 selections per stratum.
- Calibrator: one shared `alpha` clipped to `[0, 1]`; no intercept or gene/target-specific parameters.
- Primary gate: at least 2% held-out MSE improvement versus both zero and the uncalibrated shrinker.
- No alternative seeds, anchor sizes, bounds, repartitioning, or post-test refitting are permitted.

## Frozen anchor targets

`ACTR1B`, `ARGLU1`, `ARL2`, `C9orf78`, `COPS2`, `DAP3`, `GFM1`, `GLRX5`, `GTF3C6`, `HUWE1`, `KRI1`, `LSM12`, `METTL1`, `MRPL39`, `MRPL49`, `MRPL50`, `MRPS16`, `MRPS35`, `ORC3`, `POLRMT`, `RBMX2`, `RIOK1`, `SCAP`, `SLC1A5`, `SRPRB`, `TEX10`, `TIMM44`, `TRAPPC1`, `TRAPPC5`, `UBA2`, `UFM1`, `ZNHIT3`

## Integrity

- Protocol SHA-256: `0f0bb326b4626db97c2f97a2cc01d47683a2daccef81e78497cc9a50e3f96f79`
- Eligible-task input SHA-256: `4b329d018bee11e0cd5e081317f2469e6330d6ba19fc6d584d6a5a56bc24ff0a`
- Partition SHA-256: `5e90442c9179efcbb21d41840f69895e733b9f158ce22f3a2d4fb6d79ea54667`
- Outcome files read by the partition generator: none.

## Claim boundary

Success would support few-shot calibration in this KOLF screen only. It would not establish zero-shot utility, broad cell-type generalization, causal mechanism, or deployment readiness. Cells, guides, genes, and perturbation tasks are not independent screen-level biological replicates.

# V10 biology/quality separation core result

**Pre-permutation decision:** `V10_CORE_NO_GO__FROZEN_FALSIFICATION_STILL_REQUIRED`

- Primary three-supergroup A4 improvement: 0.266%
- Secondary four-group A4 improvement: 11.956%
- Purified study balanced accuracy: 64.743%
- Raw/purified target retrieval AUC: 0.8455 / 0.5629
- Feng expression header/values opened: `False` / `False`

## Primary supergroups

| Held-out supergroup | A2 biology only | A4 biology + quality gate |
|---|---:|---:|
| kolf | -15.198% | 0.422% |
| pie_supergroup | 4.830% | 0.000% |
| southard_rpe1 | 0.489% | 10.410% |

## Frozen pre-permutation gates

- g1_study_identity_removed: `False`
- g2_same_target_retrieval_preserved: `False`
- g3_four_group_pooled_at_least_ten_percent: `True`
- g4_three_supergroup_safety_and_benefit: `False`
- g5_four_group_safety_and_benefit: `True`
- g7_gate_improves_ungated_worst_group_without_large_pooled_cost: `True`
- g8_tail_direction_positive: `True`

This is post-hoc development, not independent confirmation. The final V10 decision also requires the frozen 100-permutation target-pairing falsification and an independent output audit.

SHA-256: fe7ca37472e0c17190b735b25ce357c04d8d9e57ef1dc967e4a0f99d4d060532

# PerturbCompass V10：生物状态—研究/测量质量分离方案

状态：**方案草案，尚未冻结、尚未运行**  
日期：2026-10-21  
开发数据：V8/V9 的四个研究组；Nadig 与 Replogle 在主分析中合并为一个 PIE supergroup  
外部数据：Feng 继续封存，不用于设计、调参或模型选择

## 1. 一句话方案

V10 不再把所有 target-control 特征混在一个模型里。它建立两个权限不同的通道：

- **生物通道**回答“根据目标细胞的稳定生物状态，应该迁移多少”；
- **质量通道**只回答“这次测量是否可靠、该把生物建议打几折”；
- 最终收缩系数为 `alpha_final = reliability × alpha_biology`，质量特征不能直接改变预测方向，只能把不可信预测收缩回安全基线 `alpha=0`。

这是一种可操作的统计分离，不是因果意义上已经证明“哪些变化纯生物、哪些纯技术”。如果生物状态与研究来源在现有数据里完全共线，V10 必须得出“现有数据无法识别，需要桥接实验”，而不是强行给出一个看似漂亮的模型。

## 2. 为什么需要 V10

V9 已经给出四条直接证据：

1. 纯目标状态平均改善 11.413%，但 KOLF 恶化 12.518%。
2. 加入方差和细胞数等质量代理后改善达到 15.675%，最接近 V8 的 16.80%。
3. 目标状态特征预测研究来源的准确率为 97.640%，平衡准确率为 75.227%。
4. 合并两个相关 PIE 数据集后，纯目标模型汇总改善只剩 2.134%。

因此 V10 的问题不是“还能不能再涨一点平均分”，而是：

> 能否保留跨研究稳定的目标生物信息，同时把细胞数、方差、缺失率、测量覆盖度和研究指纹限制在可靠性门控中，从而消除 KOLF 伤害？

## 3. 预注册假设

- **H1（可分离性）**：target-control 表征中存在跨研究重复的 target-specific 生物成分，也存在可由质量代理解释的研究/测量成分。
- **H2（权限分离）**：质量信息适合预测“某个生物建议是否可信”，但不应直接预测收缩方向或收缩系数。
- **H3（安全性）**：质量门控可以显著减少最差研究组的伤害，同时保留大部分纯化生物信号。
- **H4（可证伪）**：如果降低研究来源可预测性时，靶基因重复性和迁移收益同步消失，则现有数据不支持可识别的生物—质量分离。

## 4. 数据和独立单位

- 真正的泛化单位是**独立研究/筛选体系**，不是细胞、基因、guide 或任务。
- 主分析使用 3 个 supergroup：`KOLF`、`PIE supergroup`、`Southard RPE1`。
- 四组拆分（KOLF、Nadig、Replogle、Southard）仅作与 V9 的次要可比分析。
- 细胞和任务是研究内重复测量，不能把 3,602 个任务解释成 3,602 次独立跨研究复制。
- 新研究的未扰动 control 可以用于无监督中心化和质量估计，但不得读取该研究的扰动结果；这是明确标注的 transductive target-context 场景。

## 5. 双通道模型

### 5.1 生物原始通道 B

仅允许包含目标 control 的生物状态量：

- target-control program mean；
- 靶基因表达量及是否表达；
- 靶基因对应调控程序活性；
- program gene fraction；
- 由训练研究发现的跨研究稳定程序轴。

主生物通道禁止使用：control 方差、目标/对照细胞数、缺失覆盖度、研究 ID、平台 ID和 source-response geometry。

### 5.2 质量通道 Q

质量通道单独包含：

- target-control global/program variance；
- `log1p(target_cells)` 与 `log1p(control_cells)`；
- measured-gene coverage、missingness、零值比例；
- 目标 control 相对本研究整体分布的 OOD 分数；
- 若元数据真实存在，再加入测序深度、批次、平台等明确技术变量。

研究 ID 可用于训练期的诊断或 nuisance 估计，但不得作为部署预测特征。

### 5.3 生物净化器

每个外层训练折内依次执行，所有参数只从训练研究学习：

1. **研究内稳健标尺**：对每个 program 使用 control-only 中位数/MAD 和分位数表示，去除全局尺度差异；新研究只用其未扰动 controls 计算无监督标尺。
2. **质量残差化**：在训练折中拟合 `B_raw ~ Q` 的正则化模型，取残差作为 `B_residual`；正则强度在内层按研究分组选择。
3. **稳定程序投影**：用训练研究中的重复靶基因估计每个 program 的“target 可重复变异”和“study 变异”，只保留 target 成分高、study 成分低的程序轴。
4. **生物保持检查**：纯化后同一 target 跨研究的相似度/检索能力不得明显下降，否则判定为过度校正。

不把深度对抗网络设为主方案。现有数据只有 3 个独立 supergroup，深度模型很容易把研究标签隐藏起来却同时删除真实细胞状态。线性 domain-adversarial 或 DANN 仅作为探索性对照，不能替代主结论。

### 5.4 生物预测头

使用可审计的 ridge 模型从 `B_pure` 预测 program-level oracle shrinkage：

`alpha_biology = clip(sigmoid(ridge(B_pure)), 0, 1)`

程序数候选、ridge 强度和残差化强度全部在内层分组交叉验证中确定。程序发现、标准化、残差化和稳定轴选择必须全部位于相应训练折内。

### 5.5 质量可靠性头

质量头的监督目标不是 oracle alpha，而是：**生物头的外折预测相对 alpha=0 是否真正降低误差**。

- 先在训练研究中生成严格 out-of-fold 的生物头预测；
- 再用 Q 特征拟合一个校准模型，输出 `reliability ∈ [0,1]`；
- 质量头不能接触同一次拟合产生的训练内误差；
- 极端 OOD、质量过低或 control 数量不足时，可靠性强制趋近 0。

最终：

`alpha_final = reliability(Q, OOD) × alpha_biology(B_pure)`

这样质量只能说“少信一点”，不能凭研究指纹制造一个方向。

## 6. 固定消融矩阵

| 编号 | 模型 | 目的 |
|---|---|---|
| A0 | V9 M2 pure target | 原始生物状态基线 |
| A1 | Q-only 直接预测 alpha | 负面对照，量化质量捷径有多强；永不作为候选主模型 |
| A2 | 纯化生物头，无质量门控 | 判断净化后是否仍保留生物预测力 |
| A3 | 原始生物头 + 质量门控 | 判断仅做权限分离是否足够 |
| A4 | **纯化生物头 + 质量门控** | V10 唯一预指定主模型 |
| A5 | A4 去掉质量残差化 | 定位残差化贡献 |
| A6 | A4 去掉稳定程序轴 | 定位跨研究稳定性筛选贡献 |
| A7 | V9 M4 quality proxy | 与“把质量直接喂给模型”比较 |

不根据开发结果在 A2–A7 中事后挑冠军；A4 是唯一进入正式门槛的模型，其余只解释机制。

## 7. 验证结构

### 主分析：三 supergroup 外层留一

每次完整留出 KOLF、PIE supergroup 或 Southard。剩余研究中再做内层 grouped CV，完成全部超参数选择和表示学习。

### 次分析：四组留一

保留 V9 的 KOLF/Nadig/Replogle/Southard 四组设置，用于直接比较，但不再把两个 PIE 成功视为两个完全独立的泛化证据。

### 统计与不确定性

- 主指标：equal-task macro MSE relative reduction vs `alpha=0`。
- 同时报告每个 supergroup、每个原始组、最差组、5%/10% 尾部任务。
- target-cluster bootstrap 只描述研究内不确定性，不能冒充研究间置信区间。
- 只有 3 个独立 supergroup，不使用任务级 p 值声称跨研究显著。

## 8. 必做反证

1. **靶基因身份置换**：在研究/靶基因重复结构内置换 B 的 target identity，Q 和 source effects 保持不变；至少 100 次。
2. **质量交换**：在同一研究内匹配生物状态后交换 Q，确认质量只改变 reliability，不系统性制造 alpha 方向。
3. **研究来源探针**：用 target-grouped CV 从 `B_pure` 预测研究来源，与 V9 的 75.227% 平衡准确率比较。
4. **生物保持探针**：比较纯化前后同一 target 跨研究的检索 AUC/相似度，以及 target-program 结构保持率。
5. **过度校正反证**：如果研究来源预测率下降，但同一 target 的跨研究重复性也同步下降，则不算成功。
6. **OOD 压力测试**：人为抬高方差、降低细胞数或制造缺失，确认 reliability 单调下降且预测回退到 `alpha=0`。
7. **负面对照程序**：housekeeping/低生物变异程序只用于估计 nuisance，不得产生 target-specific 收益。

## 9. V10 开发门槛

所有门槛必须同时通过，不能用平均分补偿安全失败：

| 门槛 | 预定要求 |
|---|---|
| G1 研究指纹下降 | `B_pure` 的研究来源平衡准确率 ≤45%，且比 V9 至少下降 20 个百分点 |
| G2 生物保持 | 同一 target 跨研究检索/相似度相对 B_raw 下降不超过 5% |
| G3 四组平均价值 | 四组等任务汇总改善 ≥10% |
| G4 supergroup 稳健性 | 三 supergroup 汇总改善 ≥8%；任一 supergroup 伤害不超过 1%；至少 2/3 改善 ≥2% |
| G5 原始组安全性 | 四个原始组均不恶化超过 1%，至少 3/4 改善 ≥2% |
| G6 基因特异性 | 真实配对高于置换 95% 分位数至少 1 个百分点，而不只是“刚刚超过” |
| G7 门控有实际作用 | 相比 A2，A4 的最差组改善至少 5 个百分点；汇总收益损失不超过 3 个百分点 |
| G8 尾部与审计 | 去掉最有利 1% 任务后方向仍为正；独立输出审计和冻结哈希全部通过 |

### 结果解释矩阵

- G1/G2 通过、性能门槛通过：支持“可操作分离成功”，才允许进入 Feng。
- G1/G2 通过、性能失败：分离可能成功，但剩余生物信号不足以预测；No-Go。
- 性能通过、G1 或 G2 失败：仍可能依赖研究捷径或过度校正；No-Go。
- 全部失败：现有观察数据不可识别，必须做桥接实验，而不是继续堆模型。

## 10. Feng 一次性外部检验

Feng 在 V10 全部开发门槛通过前继续封存。若获得进入资格：

- 冻结代码、环境、特征、超参数、随机种子和审计脚本；
- Feng 只允许打开一次数值，不重新调参、不更换表示、不挑子集；
- 外部门槛建议预定为：汇总改善 ≥5%，预定子组伤害不超过 1%，研究指纹和 OOD 审计通过；
- Feng 成功只能支持“在一个额外数据集复现”，不能证明普遍适用于所有细胞类型和实验平台。

## 11. 真正解决可识别性的桥接实验

如果现有数据中“一个研究≈一种生物背景≈一种技术平台”，任何算法都无法从统计上彻底区分三者。V10 应同时提出最小桥接设计：

- 每个技术批次至少包含两个生物背景/条件，避免 batch 与 biology 一一对应；
- 同一 anchor control/参考细胞背景跨所有批次和平台重复；
- 生物条件在批次、孔位和处理顺序中随机化或分块；
- 每个组合需要独立批次复制，细胞数不是独立复制数；
- 每批保留并记录细胞数、测序深度、检测基因数、方差、零值率和平台信息；
- 精确批次数在确定预期最小效应和方差后，用模拟功效分析决定，不用“更多细胞”替代“更多独立批次”。

这个设计才能让模型看到“相同 biology、不同 quality”和“不同 biology、相同 quality”，从根本上提供分离所需的信息。

## 12. 实施顺序和产物

1. 数据可识别性审计：重叠 target、可用 Q 元数据、每研究 control 数量、稳定 program 数量。
2. 冻结 `configs/v10_bio_quality_separation.yaml` 与协议、输入哈希和 Feng 防火墙。
3. 实现 `src/perturbcompass/v10.py`、训练脚本、全部消融与单元测试。
4. 先跑表示诊断 G1/G2；若失败，立即停止性能追逐并判定需要桥接数据。
5. 通过后再跑嵌套开发验证、100 次置换、质量交换、OOD 压力测试。
6. 独立审计重新计算全部指标和门槛；只有全通过才生成 Feng 解封资格。

建议输出：

- `docs/audit/v10_protocol_freeze.md`
- `docs/audit/v10_predevelopment_manifest.json`
- `docs/audit/v10_identifiability_audit.json`
- `data/derived/v10/v10_grouped_task_metrics.csv`
- `docs/audit/v10_disentanglement_diagnostics.json`
- `docs/audit/v10_final_summary.json`
- `docs/audit/v10_output_audit.json`

## 13. 方法依据与边界

- RUV-III-NB 展示了利用 pseudo-replicates 和负对照基因估计 unwanted variation 的原则；V10 仅借用其设计思想，因为当前主数据是摘要级而非完整单细胞计数。https://doi.org/10.1093/nar/gkac486
- scDisInFact 明确建模 batch 与 condition 的分离，同时指出当每个 batch 只有一个 condition 时无法充分解缠，这直接支持 V10 的桥接实验要求。https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-024-45227-w
- 单细胞整合基准强调必须同时评估 batch removal 与 biological conservation，避免只追求“研究标签不可预测”造成过度校正。https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-021-01336-8
- Domain-adversarial training 提供“任务可预测、domain 不可预测”的表示思想；在 V10 中只作为次要对照，不作为小样本主模型。https://jmlr.org/papers/v17/15-239.html
- Kassis T, Agarwal V, He Y, Patel D, Brueckner AM. Scientific Agent Skills: A Library of Procedural Knowledge for Research Agents. arXiv:2609.00065, v2 (2026). https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2609.00065

SHA-256: 850faf81f5107ee3de6674913d97b958aff3f6c714f7130bcd9061f8dd0a1cb7

# PerturbCompass V10 closeout

**Final decision:** `V10_DEVELOPMENT_NO_GO__DO_NOT_OPEN_FENG_VALUES`

V10 completed the frozen biology/quality separation protocol on 3,602 tasks and 6,499 genes. The independent audit passed every implementation, alignment, metric, permutation, hash and Feng-firewall check. The No-Go is therefore a scientific result, not a failed run.

## Plain-language conclusion

The apparent gain is mostly tied to recognizing a study's measurement style. When Nadig and Replogle are incorrectly treated as separate validation studies, the primary A4 model improves pooled MSE by 11.956%. When they are correctly combined into one correlated PIE supergroup, the gain falls to 0.266%.

The quality gate prevents the worst KOLF harm mainly by refusing to predict: its primary median reliability is zero and 70.850% of tasks are shrunk completely to the zero baseline. That is useful as a safety behavior, but it is not evidence that V10 learned a portable biological rule.

## Frozen primary result: three independent supergroups

| Held-out supergroup | A4 relative MSE reduction vs zero |
|---|---:|
| KOLF | 0.422% |
| PIE supergroup | 0.000% |
| Southard RPE1 | 10.410% |
| **Pooled** | **0.266%** |

The pooled threshold was 8%; it failed. KOLF was no longer harmed, but PIE was completely abstained. The ungated purified biology model had 1.329% pooled gain and harmed KOLF by 15.198%; the gate rescued this failure by near-total shrinkage rather than by correcting the biological prediction.

## Why the four-group 11.956% result is not reliable

In the secondary four-group analysis, A4 improved Nadig by 14.947%, Replogle by 14.023%, Southard by 9.257%, and KOLF by only 0.408%. Nadig and Replogle are correlated PIE substudies, so training on one while testing on the other rewards recognition of shared study/protocol context. The three-supergroup analysis removes that shortcut and is the frozen primary analysis.

The negative-control quality models strengthen this interpretation. In the four-group analysis, quality-only A1 improved by 15.674% and V9's quality-proxy A7 by 16.637%, both exceeding A4. In the three-supergroup analysis those same shortcuts fell to -0.470% and 1.617%.

## Separation diagnostics

| Diagnostic | Frozen requirement | Observed | Result |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| Purified study balanced accuracy | ≤45% and ≥20 pp below V9 | 64.743%; 10.484 pp reduction | Fail |
| Same-target retrieval AUC drop | ≤5 pp | 28.264 pp (0.8455 → 0.5629) | Fail |
| Three-supergroup pooled gain | ≥8% | 0.266% | Fail |
| Four-group pooled gain | ≥10% | 11.956% | Pass, secondary only |
| Correct pairing margin over permutation 95th | ≥1 pp | -0.00038 pp | Fail |
| Gate improves ungated worst group with ≤3 pp pooled cost | Required | Passed | Pass |
| Remove most favorable 1% remains positive | >0 | 0.109% | Pass |
| Independent audit and hashes | Pass | Pass | Pass |

Purification reduced study recognition, but not enough. More importantly, it removed much of the cross-study target identity that V10 was supposed to preserve. This is over-removal without adequate deconfounding.

## Target-pairing falsification

One hundred within-study target-label permutations were run. Duplicate perturbation directions remained together; study background, quality, source effects, truths, outer program labels, selected hyperparameters and quality/OOD reliability were held fixed. The biology purifier and alpha model were refit for every permutation.

- Actual pairing improvement: 0.2662207%.
- Permutation median: 0.2631290%.
- Conservative permutation 95th percentile: 0.2666045%.
- Actual minus permutation 95th: -0.00000384 as a fraction, or -0.000384 percentage points.
- Empirical one-sided p: 0.07921.

Correct target-control pairing did not beat the frozen null margin.

## Quality-gate and OOD findings

The primary quality gate had mean reliability 0.0227, median zero, and 70.850% exact-zero reliability. Shuffling reliability within original held-out studies produced nearly the same primary performance (median 0.2625% versus actual 0.2662%). In the secondary analysis, shuffled reliability was better than actual on median (13.070% versus 11.956%). This does not support useful task-specific quality ranking.

The architectural safety property did work: quality/OOD scaling never flipped prediction direction. At eight robust standard units out of distribution, maximum reliability was below 0.05 in both analyses.

## What is established

1. Target-control summaries and measurement quality are heavily confounded in the present development data.
2. Four-group validation substantially overstates transfer because the two PIE releases are correlated.
3. The frozen quality gate can avoid severe negative transfer by abstaining.
4. The current residualization does not isolate a stable, target-specific biological signal.

## What is not established

V10 does not show causal separation of biological state from measurement quality, robust target-specific transfer, deployment readiness, or permission to inspect Feng expression values. The result is post-hoc development and cannot independently confirm itself.

## Recommended next study

Do not continue tuning another representation on the same four groups. The next useful step is a bridge experiment or bridge dataset in which biology and measurement are crossed rather than confounded:

- measure the same cell background and the same shared perturbations under at least two protocols, depths or cell-count regimes;
- randomize technical regime within biological background and block by replicate;
- include a common panel of targets spanning all three biological backgrounds;
- retain cell-level untreated controls and state-composition labels rather than only summary means;
- reserve an entire laboratory/protocol combination for validation;
- keep Feng sealed until a new, pre-frozen bridge-trained candidate passes its internal gates.

## Reproducibility record

- Targeted tests before freeze: 27 passed.
- Full repository tests before freeze: 199 passed plus 3 subtests.
- Full repository tests after completion: 199 passed plus 3 subtests.
- Frozen scientific audit was not modified. A pre-execution amendment added only NumPy-scalar JSON serialization after the standard encoder rejected `numpy.bool_`.
- Independent output audit: PASS; all frozen hashes matched.
- Feng download marker present; file size 4,480,969,391 bytes; header and values unopened.

## Method references

- RUV-III-NB: https://doi.org/10.1093/nar/gkac486
- scDisInFact: https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-024-45227-w
- Single-cell integration benchmark: https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-021-01336-8
- Domain-adversarial neural networks: https://jmlr.org/papers/v17/15-239.html
- Kassis T, Agarwal V, He Y, Patel D, Brueckner AM. *Scientific Agent Skills: A Library of Procedural Knowledge for Research Agents*. arXiv:2609.00065 (2026). https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2609.00065

SHA-256: e00fe1c1bd411efd0a27d7ee4e4110d30985512eb5b30cb009725316b5f81f99

# PerturbCompass V10 protocol freeze

Frozen: 2026-10-21, before any V10 run that reads perturbation outcomes.

## Question and claim boundary

V9 showed that target-control context carried signal, but it also identified the study with 75.227% balanced accuracy. V10 asks a narrower question: after removing the portion of target-control summaries predictable from measurement quality, does a target-biological state signal still transfer to an unseen study?

This is an operational separation, not a causal decomposition. Quality, cell type and biological state are partly confounded in the current four studies. A causal claim would require bridge samples measured across protocols. The V10 development result is post-hoc and cannot independently confirm itself.

Feng expression values remain closed. Download completion and file metadata may be checked; numeric/header content may not be opened unless every frozen gate passes.

## Independent units and nesting

The primary validation units are KOLF, PIE (Nadig and Replogle combined), and Southard. The four-original-group analysis is secondary because Nadig and Replogle are correlated PIE substudies rather than independent biological replications.

Every learned outcome-dependent quantity is nested inside leave-one-group-out validation: program discovery, biology purification, alpha regression, safety-label construction and gate selection. Hyperparameters are selected only from grouped out-of-fold predictions in the outer-training data. No task-level random split is used for transfer claims.

Robust centering/scaling of biology features is intentionally transductive: each held-out study contributes its untreated-control cohort, but never a perturbation outcome. This matches the proposed deployment setting in which target-background controls exist before perturbation prediction.

## Two channels with asymmetric permissions

The biology channel contains target-control means, target-gene expression/expressed status, target-program activity and program size. Continuous biology columns are normalized within study and then residualized against the quality channel using only outer-training rows. Binary and structural biology columns are not residualized.

The quality channel contains control variance, gene measured status, target/control cell counts, variance coverage and control nonzero coverage. It is forbidden from directly creating or reversing a response in the primary model. It may only multiply an already fitted biological prediction by a scalar in [0, 1]. An out-of-distribution support multiplier can further shrink, never amplify or flip, that prediction.

Program stability is estimated without perturbation outcomes from same-target control-program repeatability across original studies. If fewer than ten shared targets support a comparison, the safe fallback weight is one; observed weights are bounded below by 0.25.

## Fixed models

- A0: V9 raw target-control biology comparator.
- A1: quality predicts shrinkage directly; negative-control shortcut, never a candidate.
- A2: purified biology with program stability, no quality gate.
- A3: unnormalized/unpurified biology plus the quality gate.
- A4: normalized, quality-residualized biology plus program stability and quality/OOD gate; frozen primary.
- A5: A4 without quality residualization.
- A6: A4 without program-stability weighting.
- A7: V9 target plus quality-proxy comparator; never a candidate.

Biology hyperparameters are selected lexicographically by: fewest inner groups harmed by more than 1%; best worst-group relative improvement; lowest macro MSE; fewer programs; stronger alpha ridge; stronger residual ridge. The gate is selected with the same safety-first ordering from a second group-cross-fit over biological out-of-fold safety labels.

## Falsification and stress tests

The study-identity probe uses target-grouped cross-validation, preventing the same target gene from appearing in its training and validation partitions. Same-target cross-study retrieval must be largely preserved by purification.

For the target-identity permutation, unique gene labels are permuted within each original study and duplicate perturbation directions stay together. Only gene-specific biological columns are replaced. Background control state, source effects, truths, quality features, program labels, outer hyperparameters and the outer quality/OOD reliability are fixed. Biology purification and alpha regression are refitted for every permutation. This isolates whether correct gene-to-control pairing adds value beyond study background and quality.

Quality-swap tests permute scalar reliability within original held-out studies. OOD stress moves quality to eight robust standard units from the training median and must only reduce magnitude. Removing the most favorable 1% of tasks tests tail dependence.

## Gates fixed before outcomes

All eight are required:

1. Purified study balanced accuracy is at most 45% and at least 20 percentage points below V9's 75.227%.
2. Same-target cross-study retrieval AUC drops by at most 5 percentage points.
3. A4 improves pooled four-group macro MSE by at least 10% versus zero.
4. A4 improves pooled three-supergroup macro MSE by at least 8%, harms no supergroup by more than 1%, and improves at least two of three by at least 2%.
5. In the four-group analysis A4 harms no group by more than 1% and improves at least three of four by at least 2%.
6. Actual target pairing exceeds the conservative permutation 95th percentile by at least 1 percentage point.
7. Versus ungated A2, A4 improves the worst primary supergroup by at least 5 percentage points while losing no more than 3 percentage points pooled.
8. The primary pooled direction remains positive after removing the most favorable 1%, and the independent audit plus hashes pass.

Failure of any gate is a V10 No-Go and keeps Feng values closed. Frozen diagnostics are still completed after an early gate failure so the failure boundary is reproducible; no post-hoc rescue model is selected.

SHA-256: 2039f04dbee439ec6d4c6d47a32bebde54df4c5b9b5021565e0e543ad3dcf997

# PerturbCompass V11 public bridge protocol freeze

Date: 2026-10-21  
Status: implementation complete before public expression download  
Feng header opened: no  
Feng expression values opened: no

## Question

Can naturally repeated public perturbation measurements identify a response that
is stable across replicate arms, and can that repeatability be used to prevent
negative cross-context transfer without erasing biological perturbation signal?

V11 does not claim that public replicate plates are randomized wet-lab protocol
arms.  It provides an operational feasibility test: variation that repeats across
the documented sci-Plex3 culture replicates is treated as bridge-stable biology;
arm-specific variation is treated as study/measurement variation.  Biological
and technical differences may still coexist within the arm-specific component.

## Data firewall

1. The 145 MB sci-Plex2 file is a code/schema smoke test only and cannot support
   the primary conclusion.
2. The primary analysis uses the corrected scPerturb v1.4 sci-Plex3 h5ad from
   Zenodo record 13350497 plus the original GEO pData sidecar from GSE139944.
3. The harmonised h5ad is not sufficient by itself because its preparation drops
   `culture_plate`.  V11 must restore `replicate` and `culture_plate` from the GEO
   sidecar and verify either a unique cell identity or exact row-order anchors.
4. The surviving scPerturb `plate` field is never assumed to be an independent
   biological replicate.
5. Failure of metadata reconstruction or cross-arm coverage is a hard stop before
   expression analysis.
6. Feng remains sealed and is not an input to V11 development.

## Experimental unit and splits

Cells are technical observations.  The analysis unit is the pseudobulk defined by
cell line, perturbation, dose, time, replicate, and culture plate.  Controls are
matched within cell line, time, and replicate.  Random cell-level train/test splits
are forbidden.

All arm-offset estimates are cross-fitted by complete biological condition.  The
transfer analysis holds out an entire replicate arm and predicts its target context
from same-arm source contexts.  Scaling, gene programs, regression, and calibration
are fitted only on the non-held-out arm.

## Fixed analyses

- Metadata and complete-crossing audit.
- Cross-arm condition retrieval before and after cross-fitted arm-offset removal.
- Cross-fitted replicate-arm classification.
- Same-arm cross-context transfer with zero, raw transfer, global shrinkage, and
  bridge-repeatability selective shrinkage baselines.
- Frozen V8 source-only, target-control-only, and full feature models, plus a
  bridge-selective full-model ablation.
- One hundred within-context/arm condition-label permutations.

## Fixed gates

- G1: metadata reconstruction, controls, and crossing pass.
- G2: correct cross-arm condition top-1 retrieval is at least 70% and exceeds the
  permutation 95th percentile.
- G3: corrected arm balanced accuracy is at most 60% and drops by at least 15
  percentage points.
- G4: condition-retrieval AUC drops by no more than 5 percentage points.
- G5: the primary transfer prediction improves MSE over zero by at least 5%, with
  no arm harmed by more than 2%.
- G6: bridge-selective prediction retains at least 30% useful coverage and beats
  ordinary global shrinkage.

These are engineering feasibility thresholds, not universal biological standards.
All required gates must pass before V11 is described as a successful bridge pilot.

## Claim boundary

A pass supports public-data feasibility in the tested sci-Plex3 setting.  It does
not establish causal biological/technical separation, cross-laboratory validity,
wet-lab validation, or deployment readiness.  A failure is informative and must
not be repaired by changing thresholds after viewing outcomes.

## Procedural reference

Kassis, T., Agarwal, V., He, Y., Patel, D., & Brueckner, A. M. (2026).
Scientific Agent Skills: A Library of Procedural Knowledge for Research Agents.
arXiv:2609.00065. https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2609.00065

SHA-256: 7e753d681e46921c348b48e8710fcffe5561d9152a7b7bd43817b0e415a6c9dd

# PerturbCompass V12 closeout

Status: **NO-GO** (development result; not independent confirmation).

## Plain-language conclusion

V12 replaced V11's scaling of the complete prediction with a more targeted rule:
keep the source-only prediction and continuously weight only the extra contribution
from target-control features. This recovered most of the loss caused by V11's raw
reliability scaling, but it still did not beat the uncalibrated full V8 model.

The practical result is that target-control information remains useful, while the
current single bridge-reliability score is not accurate enough to choose how strongly
that information should be used for each task.

## Prespecified results

All values below are equal-arm macro relative MSE reductions versus the zero predictor.

| Model | Improvement |
|---|---:|
| Source only | 3.8836% |
| V11 full prediction × raw bridge reliability | 4.0714% |
| V12 continuous bridge calibration | 4.4571% |
| Training-only constant blend | 4.4603% |
| Uncalibrated full V8 | 4.5312% |
| Per-task oracle convex blend (unavailable upper bound) | 4.6451% |

The V12 primary model was 0.0741 percentage points worse than the full V8 model.
The prespecified paired condition-cluster bootstrap 95% interval was -0.1172 to
-0.0382 percentage points, with bootstrap probability of a positive increment equal
to 0. The primary model was also 0.0032 percentage points worse than the constant
blend; that contrast was uncertain (95% interval -0.0278 to +0.0203 percentage
points; probability positive 0.3905).

The primary model achieved 4.4571%, below the frozen 5% total-improvement gate. It was
slightly worse than full V8 in both held-out arms (-0.0435 and -0.1092 percentage
points), but both differences remained inside the frozen no-harm margin of -0.2
percentage points.

Frozen gates: input integrity PASS; leakage firewall PASS; total 5% improvement FAIL;
increment over full FAIL; arm safety PASS; non-degenerate weights PASS; increment over
constant blend FAIL.

## Planned upper-bound diagnostic

The oracle convex blend used held-out truths and therefore cannot be deployed. Even
this oracle reached only 4.6451% total improvement and added 0.1140 percentage points
over full V8, below both the 5% total gate and the 0.15-percentage-point incremental
gate. The observed source/full convex-blend family therefore had insufficient headroom
to meet V12's frozen success definition.

## Clearly post-primary exploratory interpretation

These diagnostics were run only after the frozen V12 conclusion and cannot change it.

- Full V8 exceeded source-only by 0.6476 percentage points (condition-bootstrap 95%
  interval 0.4080 to 0.8856; probability positive 1.0), reproducing the useful
  target-control signal.
- Bridge reliability had a weak positive rank association with the added benefit of
  full V8 (Spearman 0.2377 overall; 0.2654 and 0.2217 by arm). It ranks broad tendency,
  but not the required weight precisely.
- The two arm-specific isotonic curves differed by mean absolute weight 0.0466 on a
  fixed grid and by as much as 0.2042. The learned mapping was not fully stable.
- V12 used intermediate weights for 99.37% of tasks (median 0.6017), while the
  training-only constant weights were 0.8014 and 0.8309. In 90.68% of tasks, the
  fitted continuous weight was below the corresponding constant comparator, showing
  systematic over-shrinkage.
- Bridge reliability and the separately computed measurement-quality score were
  weakly negatively associated (Spearman -0.1866). They should remain separate rather
  than be treated as interchangeable measurements.

## Important V11 terminology correction

Inspection of the frozen V11 code showed that the V11 `v8_full_bridge_selective`
prediction was `full_prediction × bridge_reliability`, a continuous scaling rule.
The value 0.50 was used for a coverage gate, not as a prediction on/off switch. Any
earlier description of the V11 primary prediction as a literal 0.50 hard gate should
be corrected. V12 remains a distinct test because it learned a monotone mapping and
applied it only to the full-minus-source target-control increment.

## Decision

Retain uncalibrated full V8 as the current best deployable model on this public
development dataset. Do not continue tuning a one-dimensional reliability-to-weight
curve on sci-Plex3, and do not open Feng on the basis of V12.

A defensible next study needs either an independent public bridge dataset with at least
three study/replicate arms, or a pre-frozen program-level model that keeps biological
repeatability and measurement quality as separate predictors and is evaluated by
leave-one-study-out validation. Any such method must be frozen before Feng is opened.

## Evidence record

- E1: `docs/audit/v12_continuous_bridge_protocol_freeze.md` and
  `docs/audit/v12_continuous_bridge_preoutcome_manifest.json` (machine integrity
  verified; human scientific review pending).
- E2: `docs/audit/v12_continuous_bridge_core_summary.json` (prespecified results;
  machine recomputed).
- E3: `docs/audit/v12_continuous_bridge_output_audit.json` (20/20 checks PASS).
- E4: `docs/audit/v12_posthoc_diagnostics.json` (explicitly post-primary exploratory).
- E5: `data/derived/v12/v12_task_metrics.csv` (3,969 tasks; 710 condition clusters).

Feng status: header unopened; expression values unopened.

## Scientific Agent Skills citation

Kassis, T., Agarwal, V., He, Y., Patel, D., & Brueckner, A. M. (2026). Scientific
Agent Skills: A Library of Procedural Knowledge for Research Agents. arXiv:2609.00065.
https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2609.00065

SHA-256: 3ea2dbc62451c91ef5437d5cdbede3083a8a684d4b116504c20377e3de23e531

# PerturbCompass V12 pre-outcome protocol freeze

Frozen UTC: 2026-10-22T00:24:25.415067+00:00

## Primary question

Can a training-only, monotone continuous bridge weight improve the target-control increment over both the unweighted full V8 model and a training-only constant blend?

## Frozen decomposition

`prediction = source_only + w(bridge_repeatability) * (full - source_only)`

Only the target-control increment is calibrated. Measurement quality remains a separate descriptive safety variable and is not an input to the primary calibrator.
The historical V11 comparator is raw bridge-reliability scaling of the complete full-model prediction; the 0.50 component gate is a separate V12 secondary comparator, not a description of the V11 implementation.

## Leakage firewall

- Outer evaluation leaves one complete replicate arm out.
- In the training arm, five-fold cross-fitting groups all contexts of a biological condition together.
- Oracle blend targets are computed only for inner out-of-fold training predictions.
- The final isotonic map is fitted without held-out-arm truths.
- The held-out arm is scored once after model and calibrator fitting.

## Frozen primary gates

- Total relative MSE reduction vs zero >= 0.05
- Increment over full V8 >= 0.0015, with paired condition-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0
- Each arm increment over full V8 >= -0.002
- Intermediate weight fraction >= 0.1 and weight IQR >= 0.05
- Increment over constant blend >= 0.0005 and bootstrap probability positive >= 0.95

## Claim boundary

This is method development on sci-Plex3, which was already used in V11. It is not independent confirmation, causal biological/technical separation, wet-lab validation, or deployment validation. The Feng data remain sealed.

## Required citation for Scientific Agent Skills

Kassis, T., Agarwal, V., He, Y., Patel, D., & Brueckner, A. M. (2026). Scientific Agent Skills: A Library of Procedural Knowledge for Research Agents. arXiv:2609.00065. https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2609.00065

SHA-256: 43e970671f544cdf5f58a175f19965ab61f7d19684d9ad873b14893d5230687f

# PerturbCompass V13 development closeout

Status: **STOP_NO_HEADROOM**  
Analysis stage: prespecified Stage A only  
Stage B executed: **no**  
Independent computational audit: **PASS (36/36 checks)**

## Plain-language result

V13 tested the best-case value of choosing a separate target-control amount for each
gene program. The best-case oracle was allowed to see the true held-out response when
choosing each program weight. It is therefore an unavailable upper bound, not a model
that could be deployed.

Even this oracle improved the V13 full model by only **0.2660 percentage points**. The
frozen continuation threshold was **0.50 percentage points**. Its total improvement
versus the zero predictor was **4.7504%**, below the frozen **5.20%** headroom threshold.
Both headroom gates failed, so Stage B was not run.

## Frozen Stage-A results

| Quantity | Result | Frozen requirement | Decision |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| Input, structure and prior-audit integrity | pass | pass | pass |
| Held-out-truth and program-discovery leakage audit | pass | pass | pass |
| Program-oracle total improvement vs zero | 4.7504% | at least 5.20% | fail |
| Program-oracle increment over V13 full | +0.2660 percentage points | at least +0.50 points | fail |

Reference performance on the same development tasks:

| Model | Relative MSE reduction vs zero |
|---|---:|
| V13 source-only, fixed program partition | 3.9807% |
| V13 full, fixed program partition | 4.4844% |
| V13 per-program oracle upper bound | 4.7504% |
| Audited V12 full | 4.5312% |
| Audited V12 task-level continuous calibration | 4.4571% |

The analysis contained 3,969 transfer tasks, 710 perturbation/dose/time condition
clusters, 2,000 genes, and two natural replicate arms. Eight programs were learned
separately inside each outer training arm from source inputs only.

## Interpretation

The result supports a bounded negative conclusion: on the reused sci-Plex3 development
benchmark and under the frozen V13 program definition, most of the useful
target-control signal is already captured by the complete V8 model. There is some
program-localized headroom, but not enough to justify fitting and selecting a more
complex deployable calibrator under the prespecified rule.

This does not show that program-wise control weighting can never work. It does show
that continuing to tune the current V13 formulation on the same dataset would have a
low ceiling and would violate the frozen sequential decision. Any renewed attempt must
be a new, explicitly exploratory version with a materially different source of program
structure or evidence, rather than a post-result relaxation of V13 thresholds.

## Integrity and claim boundary

- The independent audit reconstructed task MSE from task-program rows, recomputed all
  model summaries, gates, hashes and the final status; all 36 checks passed.
- Stage B was not executed.
- Feng headers and expression values remained unopened.
- This is method-development evidence from a reused dataset, not independent
  confirmation, wet-lab validation, or a deployment claim.
- The Stage-A gates are deterministic point-estimate gates. The computational audit
  validates implementation and arithmetic; it is not a confidence interval for
  biological generalization.

## Evidence provenance

- Frozen protocol: `docs/audit/v13_program_level_control_protocol_freeze.md`
- Frozen manifest: `docs/audit/v13_program_level_control_preoutcome_manifest.json`
- Stage-A summary: `docs/audit/v13_stage_a_summary.json`
- Independent audit: `docs/audit/v13_stage_a_output_audit.json`
- Task metrics: `data/derived/v13/v13_stage_a_task_metrics.csv`
- Task-program metrics: `data/derived/v13/v13_stage_a_program_metrics.csv`

## Reference

Kassis, T., Agarwal, V., He, Y., Patel, D., & Brueckner, A. M. (2026). Scientific
Agent Skills: A Library of Procedural Knowledge for Research Agents. arXiv:2609.00065.
https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2609.00065

SHA-256: bb0c6eca162b1c1953e0c34a0ec05d32b4609ef068de2827fe336bb3bbee50cf

# PerturbCompass V13: program-level target-control calibration proposal

Status: **proposal only; no V13 outcome has been computed**.

## Objective

V13 asks whether target-control information should be added in different amounts for
different gene programs. The model keeps the source-only prediction as the base and
weights only the full-minus-source target-control increment within each program.

For task `t` and program `p`:

`prediction[t,p] = source[t,p] + weight[t,p] * (full[t,p] - source[t,p])`

`weight[t,p]` is constrained to `[0, 1]`. V13 can ignore an unreliable target-control
increment but cannot reverse it or extrapolate beyond the full model.

## Why this is the next justified step

V12 showed that full V8 exceeded source-only by 0.6476 percentage points, but a single
task-level reliability weight made performance 0.0741 percentage points worse than
full V8. A per-task convex-blend oracle added only 0.1140 percentage points over full.
This supports keeping target-control information while testing whether useful and
harmful increments are localized to different gene programs.

These are development observations from sci-Plex3, not independent confirmation.

## Model structure

V13 retains eight training-arm-derived gene programs. It does not fit eight unrelated
models. Program-task rows are pooled in one regularized model:

`logit(weight[t,p]) = intercept + ridge-shrunk program offset[p] + biology channel + quality channel`

The primary calibrator is an additive weighted ridge model. Program identity is
one-hot encoded and penalized, so weak programs shrink toward the common model.
Candidate ridge penalties are `[0.1, 1, 10, 100]`, selected only inside grouped
training-arm cross-validation.

The calibration target is the program-specific oracle convex weight:

`oracle_weight = clip(<truth-source, full-source> / ||full-source||^2, 0, 1)`

Rows are weighted by `||full-source||^2 / number_of_genes`, matching their exact
contribution to macro gene-level MSE. Near-zero increments cannot dominate training.

## Separate input channels

Biological-state/repeatability features:

- program source-response magnitude;
- source-context consensus, disagreement, cosine agreement and sign agreement;
- source-to-target control-state distance within the program;
- target-control program activity and perturbation-gene state;
- program-specific cross-arm repeatability computed only from the focal task's source
  contexts, never from its target-context truth.

Measurement-quality features:

- program-level target-control variance;
- target and control cell counts;
- measured-gene fraction and finite-support indicators;
- number of supporting control/pseudobulk units when recoverable from the audited V11
  pseudobulk metadata.

All feature normalization is fitted on the training arm. The primary model is additive
with no biology-by-quality interaction. This preserves the distinction between the two
channels. An interaction model may be reported only as exploratory.

## Leakage firewall and replication unit

- Cells are technical observations.
- The inferential cluster is the perturbation/dose/time condition (710 clusters in the
  current development bundle).
- The outer evaluation unit is the complete replicate arm.
- Outer loop: leave one complete arm out.
- Within the training arm, a deterministic 20% condition subset defines the stable
  gene-program partition from source inputs only. Its target truths are not calibration
  targets.
- Remaining training conditions produce source/full out-of-fold predictions with
  five-fold GroupKFold; all contexts of a condition stay together.
- A second four-fold condition-grouped loop selects the ridge penalty for the
  program-level calibrator.
- The final calibrator is fitted on training-arm out-of-fold rows and evaluated once on
  the held-out arm.
- Matched held-out-arm source contexts and target controls are permitted task inputs;
  the held-out target-context perturbation truth is never fitted or transformed.

## Sequential feasibility gate

V13 is intentionally two-stage.

### Stage A: program-oracle headroom

Before fitting the deployable calibrator, compute the unavailable per-task/per-program
oracle upper bound under the frozen program partition. Continue only if both hold:

- oracle total relative MSE improvement versus zero is at least 5.20%;
- oracle increment over uncalibrated full V8 is at least 0.50 percentage points.

This margin is larger than the final 5.00%/0.15-point success requirement because a
learned model cannot be expected to reach its oracle ceiling. Failure produces
`STOP_NO_HEADROOM`; no model tuning follows.

### Stage B: nested program-level learning

Run only if Stage A passes. The primary model is the additive biology-plus-quality
program calibrator. Hyperparameter selection remains inside the training arm.

## Frozen comparator set

1. zero prediction;
2. source-only V8;
3. full V8 (`weight = 1` for every program);
4. V12 task-level continuous calibration;
5. one global training-only constant weight;
6. one training-only constant weight per gene program (strongest simple comparator);
7. program biology-only calibrator;
8. program quality-only calibrator;
9. program biology-plus-quality calibrator (primary);
10. program oracle upper bound (diagnostic only, never a candidate).

No comparator may be added after V13 outcomes are viewed.

## Primary success gates

- G1: all frozen input hashes and V11/V12 audits pass; V8 baselines reproduce.
- G2: no held-out truth, condition or program-row leakage; all inner condition overlaps
  are zero.
- G3: Stage-A oracle headroom passes.
- G4: primary total relative MSE improvement versus zero is at least 5.00%.
- G5: primary increment over full V8 is at least 0.15 percentage points and the paired
  condition-cluster bootstrap 95% interval has lower bound above zero.
- G6: primary increment over per-program constant weights is at least 0.05 percentage
  points with bootstrap probability positive at least 0.95.
- G7: neither held-out arm is worse than full V8 by more than 0.20 percentage points.
- G8: weights are non-degenerate: at least 20% lie strictly between 0.05 and 0.95, and
  the median task has a cross-program weight range of at least 0.10.

Status rules:

- `GO`: G1-G8 all pass.
- `METHOD_SIGNAL_ONLY`: G1-G3, G5 and G7 pass but G4, G6 or G8 fails.
- `STOP_NO_HEADROOM`: G1-G2 pass and G3 fails; Stage B is not run.
- `NO_GO`: otherwise.

## Channel-separation verdict (secondary)

The primary GO decision does not force both channels to be useful. Channel evidence is
reported separately using paired condition-cluster bootstrap contrasts:

- `BOTH_CHANNELS_SUPPORTED`: additive model beats both single-channel ablations by at
  least 0.05 percentage points and both intervals exclude zero;
- `BIOLOGY_DOMINANT` or `QUALITY_DOMINANT`: only one ablation contrast passes;
- `CHANNELS_UNRESOLVED`: neither passes.

These labels are operational predictive evidence, not causal separation.

## Reporting and audit

- Equal-arm macro MSE is the primary endpoint.
- Conditions, not task rows or cells, are resampled in 2,000 paired bootstrap draws.
- All planned models and negative results are reported.
- Program membership, program sizes, feature missingness, selected penalties,
  calibration coefficients, arm-specific performance and weight distributions are
  retained.
- Save task-level and task-program-level metrics, not full prediction matrices, because
  server disk space is limited.
- An independent script recomputes every primary point estimate, bootstrap contrast,
  gate and hash.

## Expected runtime and stop points

- Code, synthetic tests and freeze: no biological outcome access.
- Stage A: approximately 8-15 minutes on the current server.
- Stage B if permitted: approximately 15-30 additional minutes.
- The user is notified before each long stage and the task pauses while it runs.

## Claim boundary

V13 remains development on the already-used sci-Plex3 data. A GO would justify an
independent frozen confirmation, not a deployment or wet-lab claim. Feng remains sealed
through V13 development. Opening Feng requires a separate confirmatory protocol and
unchanged code/model hashes.

## Scientific Agent Skills citation

Kassis, T., Agarwal, V., He, Y., Patel, D., & Brueckner, A. M. (2026). Scientific
Agent Skills: A Library of Procedural Knowledge for Research Agents. arXiv:2609.00065.
https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2609.00065

# PerturbCompass V13 frozen development protocol

Status: **FROZEN BEFORE V13 OUTCOMES**

## Estimand

For each task and source-derived gene program, learn a bounded weight in
`source + weight * (full - source)`. The primary endpoint is equal-arm macro MSE.

## Leakage firewall

- Hold out one complete replicate arm for outer evaluation.
- Learn eight programs only from source inputs in a deterministic 20% subset of training conditions.
- Do not use discovery-condition truths as calibration targets.
- Cross-fit source/full predictions by condition on the remaining training conditions.
- Select the calibrator penalty in a second condition-grouped loop.
- Never fit or transform on held-out target-context perturbation truth.

## Sequential stop

Stage B runs only if the program oracle reaches 5.20% total improvement and adds at least 0.50 percentage points over V13 full.

## Stage-B primary gates

- Total improvement >= 5.00%.
- Increment over full >= 0.15 percentage points with paired condition-bootstrap CI above zero.
- Increment over per-program constant >= 0.05 percentage points with bootstrap probability >= 0.95.
- No arm worse than full by more than 0.20 percentage points.
- Intermediate weights >= 20% and median task cross-program range >= 0.10.

## Frozen files

- `configs/v13_program_level_control_calibration.yaml`: `85f6a9f9acdca330cfc67bd17e0015cb100d55ee20ad077256a45e881fcfd03e`
- `docs/audit/v13_program_level_control_calibration_proposal.md`: `bb0c6eca162b1c1953e0c34a0ec05d32b4609ef068de2827fe336bb3bbee50cf`

- `scripts/run_v13_stage_a.py`: `2d5fc39f3a0ba759cd23d4d28e06d8e2fa31182e20b281cdc4f0cf4e379d4f1d`
- `scripts/run_v13_stage_b.py`: `0ebfe57506f748a0932b62dd287052bc796421fa84a6fb812611ad3e8003432f`

SHA-256: c9319ee15ac3422a06745baa46b2944d0acd6362cd2cf5696d6b35564881393e

# PerturbCompass V14 biology/quality separation protocol freeze

Status: **FROZEN BEFORE V14 EXPRESSION OUTCOMES**

## Question

Can a quality channel learned only from training-arm controls reduce
cross-arm control discrepancy without erasing perturbation biology, and
does that separation improve complete-heldout-arm transfer prediction?

## Frozen design

- Pilot: 92 of 613 conditions
- Selection seed: 141022
- Cells are technical observations; condition is the bootstrap cluster.
- Outer split: leave one complete replicate arm out.
- Negative controls, RUV K, QC scaling and NB coefficients are fit only
  from the training arm. Held-out perturbation truth is never an input.
- Raw integer counts are aggregated before normalization.

## Frozen primary model

The primary correction is measured QC + RUV factors followed by a
per-gene negative-binomial GLM. The biological representation is the
log-CPM matrix after subtracting only the fitted quality-channel linear
predictor, clipped at ±2 log units. Raw, QC-only and RUV-only are fixed
comparators. Adjacent K and a disjoint negative-control set are fixed
sensitivities.

Implementation amendment frozen before outcomes: the server has no R,
edgeR, DESeq2 or RUVSeq installation. V14 therefore uses statsmodels
0.14.6 negative-binomial GLMs with method-of-moments fixed dispersion.
This preserves the count likelihood and frozen design matrix but does
not claim edgeR/DESeq2 empirical-Bayes dispersion shrinkage equivalence.

## Frozen gates

- G2: control cross-arm MSE reduction ≥ 0.2
- G3: effect-norm retention ≥ 0.95; retrieval AUC drop ≤ 0.02
- G4: |Spearman rho| ≥ 0.3 for at least two QC variables; biology arm accuracy ≤ 0.6
- G5: equal-arm predictive increment ≥ 0.0015 and paired condition-bootstrap CI95 low > 0.0
- G6: every arm increment ≥ -0.002
- G7: all frozen sensitivity increments retain a positive direction.

PILOT_GO requires G0–G7. Thresholds cannot be moved after outcomes.
Feng remains sealed and Stage B is forbidden unless PILOT_GO is audited.

## Claim boundary

This is operational separation on reused sci-Plex3 development data,
not causal identification, wet-lab validation, deployment evidence, or
independent confirmation.

## References

- Squair et al. (2021). doi:10.1038/s41467-021-25960-2
- Love et al. (2014). doi:10.1186/s13059-014-0550-8
- Risso et al. (2014). doi:10.1038/nbt.2931
- Molania et al. (2022). doi:10.1038/s41587-022-01440-w
- Kassis, T., Agarwal, V., He, Y., Patel, D., & Brueckner, A. M.
  (2026). Scientific Agent Skills: A Library of Procedural Knowledge
  for Research Agents. arXiv:2609.00065.
  https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2609.00065

SHA-256: 4db81d34430477051db3fae7b67409fef24e88d113d72dbb28e8ccb543a44415

# PerturbCompass V14：生物信号与测量质量分离的先导可行性方案

状态：**预注册式研究方案；尚未运行 V14，也没有 V14 结果。**

## 一句话目标

先在 sci-Plex3 的一小部分条件上回答三个问题：

1. 能否提取一个确实反映测量质量、但不携带扰动答案的质量通道？
2. 去掉这个质量通道后，真正的扰动反应是否仍被保留？
3. 这种分离是否能稳定改善跨 replicate arm 的预测？

只有三个问题都通过，才扩大到完整开发集。Feng 数据在 V14 全程继续封存。

## 为什么现在做

V13 表明：目标 control 含有可用信号，但当前 source-target 组合没有足够的可部署余量。一个合理解释是，目标 control 同时混合了两类东西：

- **生物状态**：细胞类型、基线通路活性、目标基因与调控程序；
- **测量质量**：测序深度、细胞数、掉零、批次、孔板和噪声。

V14 不再直接把整个 target control 向量送入收缩器，而是先把它拆成“生物通道”和“质量通道”，再检验这种拆分是否真实、可复现且对预测有用。

## 结论边界

本研究最多证明**操作性分离**：在现有设计和观测变量下，一个表征更像生物、另一个更像测量质量。只有两个自然 replicate arm，而且 arm 可能同时包含技术差异和真实环境差异，因此 V14 不把任何算法输出称为因果真相。

若生物条件与批次完全混杂，算法无法凭空把二者识别开；此时必须停止，而不是用更复杂的模型掩盖问题。

## 总体路线

### 主分析：可审计的统计模型

1. 从原始整数 counts 构建 pseudobulk；聚合单位为 `arm × context × perturbation × dose × time`，若可恢复 plate/sample，则将其保留为额外区组。
2. 从未扰动 control 计算预测时可获得的质量指标：细胞数、总 UMI、检测基因数、线粒体比例（若有）、掉零率、control 离散度、有限支持率及 plate/well/batch。
3. 只在训练折内选择负对照基因；排除扰动靶基因、预声明的强响应基因和明显的生物背景标记。
4. 若技术重复/伪重复结构足够，使用 RUV-III 估计不需要的变异因子；否则降级为 RUVg + 实测 QC 协变量，并明确标记为“部分分离”。
5. 对每个基因拟合 pseudobulk 负二项 GLM：

   `count ~ biological_design + measured_QC + W + offset(log_library_size)`

6. 输出两个互不混用的对象：

   - 生物表示：保留 biological_design，将 QC 与 W 固定在参考值后的效应/残差；
   - 质量表示：实测 QC 与 W，只用于可靠性估计和收缩强度，不直接充当扰动答案。

主实现优先采用 edgeR 或 DESeq2；RUV 负责估计未观测质量因子。它们是 V14 的裁决依据。

### 次分析：非线性旁证

- **scDisInFact**：把 perturbation/context 指定为生物因素，把 arm/batch/QC 指定为非生物因素，检查单细胞层面的共同与非共同因子。
- **contrastiveVI**：可用于 control 与 treated 的共同/显著变异探索。
- **scVI**：作为计数生成与 batch-aware 基线。

深度模型只做一致性旁证；即使它优于主模型，也不能单独推翻主分析的失败结论。

## 数据单元与泄漏防火墙

- 单细胞是技术观测，不是独立生物重复。
- 推断和 bootstrap 的最小独立簇是完整 `perturbation × dose × time` 条件。
- 外层检验为 leave-one-complete-arm-out；两条 arm 的结果分别报告，再做等权平均。
- 所有归一化、负对照基因筛选、RUV 因子数 K、正则化和阈值校准都只能使用训练 arm。
- held-out target 的扰动表达绝不能作为输入；held-out arm 的未扰动 control 和当时可获得的 QC 可以作为输入。
- 按条件哈希分组，任何条件不得跨训练/验证边界。
- Feng 数据不参与模型选择、阈值选择、负对照选择或调试。

## 分阶段执行

### Stage 0：可识别性与元数据审计

检查：原始 counts、arm/context/condition/control、每个 pseudobulk 的细胞数和文库量、plate/well/sample、QC 字段、条件在两 arm 中的覆盖矩阵。

必须满足：

- 至少存在跨 arm 可匹配的 control 与足够的条件覆盖；
- 生物条件与 arm/batch 不是完全一一对应；
- 每个主要分析单元有预设最低细胞数；
- RUV-III 所需的技术/伪重复和负对照结构可明确构造；否则自动使用降级方案。

若前两项失败，状态为 `STOP_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE`，不再拟合分离模型。

### Stage A：15% 条件的先导试验

- 先由元数据筛出同时覆盖两条 arm 与三个 context 的 613 个完全成对条件，再按稳定哈希抽取约 15%（92 个）；选择规则在查看任何 V14 表达结果前冻结。
- 一个条件的所有细胞和 context 始终一起进入同一折。
- 在训练 arm 内用 grouped cross-validation 选择 RUV 因子数 `K ∈ {1,2,3,4,5}`；不得用 held-out arm 的扰动真值选择 K。
- 同时运行四个冻结比较器：原始 pseudobulk、仅实测 QC、仅 RUV、实测 QC + RUV。
- V8 full 作为预测参照；V13 只作为研究历史，不作为可部署基线。

### Stage B：完整开发集

仅在 Stage A 获得 `PILOT_GO` 后运行。锁定模型、负对照规则、K 选择规则和所有阈值，在其余完全成对的 sci-Plex3 条件上一次性验证。该阶段仍是内部开发验证，不是独立外部确认。

### Stage C：独立确认

只有 Stage B 通过后，才另行冻结 Feng 揭盲协议。Feng 一次性确认不能反过来调 V14。

## 负对照基因规则

负对照基因必须在每个训练折内重选，候选基因需满足：

- 在未扰动 control 和匹配重复之间较稳定；
- 与文库量、掉零或批次差异有可解释关联；
- 不属于扰动靶基因、强扰动反应集合或预声明的核心生物通路；
- 在替代负对照集合下结论方向一致。

若无法找到稳定的负对照集合，则 RUV 结果不得进入主结论。

## 证伪测试

1. **质量标签置换**：在同一生物条件内打乱 arm/QC 标签，质量通道的关联应消失。
2. **扰动标签置换**：在同一 arm/context 内打乱 perturbation 标签，生物通道的扰动检索应降至随机附近。
3. **泄漏哨兵**：脚本硬性检查 condition hash、负对照筛选和所有 scaler 的训练范围。
4. **空条件检验**：control 与预声明 null genes 不应在校正后产生新的强扰动效应。
5. **替代集合检验**：更换负对照基因集合、K 和 QC 子集后，主效应方向应一致。
6. **通道探针**：质量通道应关联实测 QC，但不能明显识别 perturbation；生物通道应支持跨 arm 的扰动检索，且不能轻易识别 arm。

## 预先冻结的先导判据

以下阈值是 V14 的工程决策，不是文献公认定律；必须在运行前冻结。

| 门 | 判据 | 失败含义 |
|---|---|---|
| G0 可识别性 | Stage 0 的匹配、覆盖和非完全混杂均通过 | 数据本身不足以分离 |
| G1 完整性 | 100% 泄漏检查通过；无 condition 跨折 | 结果无效 |
| G2 捕获质量 | control 的跨 arm 中位 MSE 至少下降 20%，或质量因子解释至少 20% 的 control 跨 arm 差异 | 没抓住足够质量信号 |
| G3 保留生物 | 扰动-vs-control 效应范数/靶通路信号下降不超过 5%；跨 arm 扰动检索下降不超过 2 个百分点 | 校正抹掉了生物信号 |
| G4 通道分离 | 质量分数与至少两项实测 QC 的 |Spearman ρ| ≥ 0.30；质量通道识别 perturbation 不超过随机 +5pp；生物通道的 arm balanced accuracy ≤ 0.60 | 两通道仍明显混在一起 |
| G5 预测增益 | 相对 V8 full，等权双 arm macro relative-MSE reduction 至少 +0.15pp，且按 condition 配对 bootstrap 95% CI 下界 > 0 | 没有可靠预测收益 |
| G6 不伤单臂 | 任一 arm 相对 V8 full 不差于 −0.20pp | 平均值掩盖单臂伤害 |
| G7 稳健性 | 替代负对照集合和相邻 K 下方向一致，无单一条件主导 | 结论过度依赖分析选择 |

### 状态机

- `PILOT_GO`：G0–G7 全部通过；允许进入 Stage B。
- `SEPARATION_SIGNAL_ONLY`：G0–G4、G6、G7 通过但 G5 失败；说明可测到分离信号，但没有转化成预测收益，不扩大预测实验。
- `STOP_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE`：G0 失败；数据设计不足，停止。
- `NO_GO`：其余情况；停止并报告具体失败门。

禁止把“接近阈值”“某一 arm 很好”或“深度模型单独很好”改写为 `PILOT_GO`。

## 主要输出

- `v14_stage0_identifiability.json/md`
- `v14_pilot_manifest.json`（哈希条件、特征、阈值与版本）
- `v14_pseudobulk_qc.parquet`
- `v14_negative_controls_by_fold.json`
- `v14_primary_separation_metrics.csv`
- `v14_falsification_tests.csv`
- `v14_stage_a_summary.json/md`
- 独立审计记录：逐门 PASS/FAIL 与最终状态

## 预计耗时与暂停点

- Stage 0 元数据与可识别性审计：约 5–10 分钟。
- Stage A 经典 pseudobulk + RUV/NB-GLM：约 20–45 分钟，取决于 R/Bioconductor 环境与 counts 大小。
- 可选 scDisInFact：GPU 约 1–3 小时；CPU 不建议作为先导阻塞项。
- Stage B 全开发集经典模型：约 1–3 小时，只在 `PILOT_GO` 后运行。

真正进入下载或超过约 20 分钟的运行前，先向用户报告预计耗时并暂停等待确认/完成；V14 方案生成本身不触发长任务。

## 推荐结论模板

若通过：

> 在预先冻结的先导条件与 leave-one-arm-out 检验下，质量通道能解释 control 的跨 arm 差异，同时未显著削弱扰动效应，并对两个 arm 的预测产生具有正 bootstrap 下界的增益。因此允许进入完整开发集验证。

若只分得开但无预测收益：

> 数据支持操作性的生物/质量分离，但该分离尚未转化为 PerturbCompass 的可靠预测增益；因此不扩大模型集成实验。

若不可识别：

> 当前数据中生物条件与测量因素缺少足够独立变化，无法可靠识别两者；任何算法性“分离”都可能只是重命名混杂。

## 方法依据

- Squair et al. (2021), pseudobulk replication benchmark. <https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-021-25960-2>
- Love et al. (2014), DESeq2. <https://doi.org/10.1186/s13059-014-0550-8>
- Risso et al. (2014), RUVSeq. <https://www.nature.com/articles/nbt.2931>
- Molania et al. (2022), RUV-III and pseudo-replicates. <https://www.nature.com/articles/s41587-022-01440-w>
- Lopez et al. (2018), scVI. <https://www.nature.com/articles/s41592-018-0229-2>
- Weinberger et al. (2023), contrastiveVI. <https://www.nature.com/articles/s41592-023-01955-3>
- Wu et al. (2024), scDisInFact. <https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-024-45227-w>
- Kassis, T., Agarwal, V., He, Y., Patel, D., & Brueckner, A. M. (2026). *Scientific Agent Skills: A Library of Procedural Knowledge for Research Agents*. arXiv:2609.00065. <https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2609.00065>

## 最重要的决策

V14 先验证“能否可信地分开”，再验证“分开后是否提高预测”。不能提高预测也可能是一个科学结果，但不能因此继续堆模型；不能识别则必须停止。这个顺序避免把测量噪声误当生物规律，也避免把真实生物差异作为 batch 一并删除。

# PerturbCompass V14 开发结论：生物信号与测量质量分离先导试验

**结论日期：** 2026-10-22  
**冻结结论：** `NO_GO`  
**决策：** 不进入 V14 Stage B，不开启 Feng 表达矩阵；如继续，应另立 V15 协议并在看新结果前冻结。

## 一句话结论

V14 这套“只用训练臂 control、逐基因拟合测量质量，再叠加 RUV 隐变量”的分离方法没有把噪声拿掉，反而把表达差异整体放大并显著损害预测。它应被淘汰；这并不否定目标背景 control 有生物信息，也不否定 V13 的研究方向。

## 外行版解释

可以把每个基因想成一个旋钮。V14 尝试用每一折仅 **24 个 control 样本**，分别调好 **2,000 个旋钮**。结果不是把“相机噪声”校掉，而是把整张照片的对比度拉爆：每个样本的校正后表达向量都比原来更大，跨实验臂的 control 反而更不像，预测误差也明显上升。

所以本轮得到的可靠答案不是“control 没用”，而是：**当前这种高维、逐基因、仅训练臂拟合的校正方式不能用。**

## 冻结设计与数据边界

- 数据：sci-Plex3 内部开发数据；Feng 全程封存。
- 先导样本：92 个在 2 个 replicate arm × 3 个 context 中完全交叉的条件。
- 推断单位：扰动–剂量–时间条件；单细胞只作为技术观测，不当作独立重复。
- 任务数：552；基因数：2,000。
- 外层验证：每次完整留出一个 replicate arm；留出臂的扰动后表达从不参与拟合。
- 每折训练 control：24 个 pseudobulk 单元。
- 分离含义：操作性分离，不是生物学因果识别，也不是湿实验验证或独立外部确认。

## 冻结结果

| 检查项 | 预设要求 | 实际结果 | 判定 |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| G0 元数据与可识别性 | 必须通过 | 通过 | PASS |
| G1 无泄漏 | 必须通过 | 通过 | PASS |
| G2 control 跨臂 MSE | 至少下降 20% | 从 0.00315 升至 0.08781，变为 27.89 倍 | FAIL |
| G3 保留生物信号 | 效应范数保留 ≥0.95；检索 AUC 下降 ≤0.02 | 效应范数变为 5.06 倍；AUC 下降 0.0987 | FAIL |
| G4 通道分离 | biology 难以识别 arm（平衡准确率 ≤0.60） | 平衡准确率 1.00 | FAIL |
| G5 预测增益 | 增益 ≥0.0015 且 95% CI 下界 >0 | 增益 -9.033；95% CI [-11.070, -7.244] | FAIL |
| G6 两臂均不受害 | 每臂增益 ≥-0.002 | rep1 -13.697；rep2 -4.369 | FAIL |
| G7 敏感性分析 | 方向一致且为正 | 三种敏感性均为负 | FAIL |

这里的预测“增益”以零预测器 MSE 为归一化分母；`-9.033` 不是“下降 9%”，而是一个非常大的负值。更直观地看：

- 原始 V8 full 平均 MSE：**0.01873**。
- 测量 QC-only：**0.17002**，约为原始模型的 **9.08 倍**。
- RUV-only：**0.02161**，约为原始模型的 **1.15 倍**。
- 测量 QC + RUV：**0.20083**，约为原始模型的 **10.72 倍**。

## 可以确信什么

### 1. V14 当前算法不能扩展

这是冻结设计下的主结论，可信度高。失败不是刚好擦线：主效应、两条 replicate arm、三个敏感性版本和 2,000 次按条件成簇 bootstrap 全部指向伤害；bootstrap 中获得正增益的比例为 0。

### 2. 校正没有实现“生物/质量分离”

校正后 biology 表征仍能以 100% 平衡准确率识别 replicate arm；跨臂检索 AUC 从 0.6726 降到 0.5739，top-1 从 17.03% 降到 5.98%。也就是说，arm 信息没有被干净移到质量通道，真正的生物对应关系却被削弱了。

### 3. measured-QC 通道是主要伤害来源

这是事后分解诊断，不改变冻结结论。QC-only 的 MSE 已达 0.17002，而 RUV-only 为 0.02161；合并后进一步恶化到 0.20083。校正后/校正前表达向量范数的中位比为 1.338，范围 1.069–1.760，600 个 pseudobulk 单元无一缩小。

### 4. 当前 RUV 因子没有可复现的外折 QC 信号

rep1 选择 K=4 时 grouped-QC MSE 为 1.0039，rep2 选择 K=1 时为 1.1843；两者都没有优于标准化后的空模型 MSE=1。因此下一版必须允许安全地选择 `K=0/不校正`。

## 不能据此声称什么

- 不能声称目标背景 control 没有信息。V14 检验的是一种具体分离器，不是 control 价值本身。
- 不能声称逐基因高维拟合一定是唯一原因。它是由分解、样本数和范数膨胀共同支持的最强机制假说，但属于事后诊断。
- 不能声称已经得到可部署模型、外部验证或湿实验因果结论。
- 不能把固定的 V11 基因集合当作独立确认；它属于历史开发选择。

## 独立审计

`v14_stage_a_output_audit.json` 对输出做了独立复算，17/17 项检查通过，包括：任务唯一性、两臂完整性、损失有限且非负、预结果清单哈希、主增益、逐臂增益、bootstrap、敏感性门槛、无泄漏以及 Feng 仍封存。复算主增益为 -9.032995340790078，与正式摘要一致。

## 下一版建议：V15 control-first、低维、可退回恒等映射

V15 不应继续修补现有逐基因模型，而应把问题改成“先证明 control 校准本身安全，再让它接触扰动预测”。

1. **使用目标臂 control 做转导式校准。** 预测时目标背景 control 本来可用；只用它们估计目标臂的测量偏移，不使用任何目标臂扰动后表达。
2. **在低维基因程序空间校准。** 先把 2,000 个基因压到少量预冻结程序，再估计共享的平移/缩放或强正则映射，避免 24 个 control 支撑 2,000 套独立参数。
3. **把“不校正”设为正式候选。** 若交叉验证不能胜过 identity/null，强制选择 `K=0` 或权重 0，禁止把无信号的校正硬加进去。
4. **先跑 control-only 小门槛。** 在不看扰动结果时，要求跨臂 control MSE 至少下降 20%、表达范数比保持在 0.95–1.05、arm probe ≤0.60；任一失败就停止。
5. **通过后才做扰动预测。** 继续沿用整臂留出、按条件成簇 bootstrap、两臂均不得受害和检索 AUC 下降 ≤0.02 的规则。
6. **另立并冻结 V15。** V14 的 `NO_GO` 永久保留；所有新阈值、低维程序、正则强度和停止规则都必须在看 V15 扰动结果前固定。

## 文件索引

- 冻结摘要：`docs/audit/v14_stage_a_summary.json`
- 独立审计：`docs/audit/v14_stage_a_output_audit.json`
- 事后诊断：`docs/audit/v14_posthoc_diagnostics.json`
- 任务级结果：`data/derived/v14/v14_stage_a_task_metrics.csv`
- 单元级结果：`data/derived/v14/v14_stage_a_unit_metrics.csv`
- 冻结协议：`docs/audit/v14_biology_quality_protocol_freeze.md`

## 方法学参考

本轮实验冻结、分阶段门控、成簇 bootstrap、主分析与事后诊断边界参考了 Scientific Agent Skills：Kassis, T., Agarwal, V., He, Y., Patel, D., & Brueckner, A. M. (2026). *Scientific Agent Skills: A Library of Procedural Knowledge for Research Agents*. arXiv:2609.00065. https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2609.00065

SHA-256: 43bf19ef8e03d671d9ab4907b3668e81263edf276011dc3b61b111450b2af562

# PerturbCompass V15 control-first transductive calibration protocol freeze

Status: **FROZEN BEFORE V15 CONTROL OUTCOMES**

## Question

Can source and target controls support a null-safe, low-dimensional
common-reference calibration that removes replicate-arm measurement
signal without erasing cell-line identity, and then improve held-out-arm
perturbation prediction after an inverse map back to raw effect space?

## Frozen design

- Input: 600 culture-plate pseudobulk units; 48 controls.
- Control replication unit: culture plate; cells are technical observations.
- Eight synchronized leave-one-plate-rank-out folds; six controls held out per fold.
- Candidate grid: 33 models including mandatory identity.
- PCA basis and arm × context moments are refit inside every control fold.
- Candidate selection uses paired control MSE and a one-standard-error
  rule that prefers identity and then lower complexity.
- Target controls are permitted transductive inputs. No target perturbation
  outcome may enter Stage A or any Stage-B fit/selection step.

## Stage-A gates

- Control cross-arm MSE reduction ≥ 0.2 with bootstrap CI95 low > 0.0.
- Norm-ratio median in [0.95, 1.05], P05 ≥ 0.9, P95 ≤ 1.1.
- Corrected arm-probe balanced accuracy ≤ 0.6.
- Corrected context-probe accuracy ≥ 0.85 with drop ≤ 0.05.
- Every context MSE reduction ≥ 0.0 and selected candidate is not identity.

READY_FOR_STAGE_B requires every Stage-A gate plus an independent audit.
A second manifest must freeze the selected candidate before perturbation
outcomes are opened for Stage B.

## Stage-B gates

- Equal-arm predictive increment over raw V8 full ≥ 0.0015 and CI95 low > 0.0.
- Every arm increment ≥ -0.002.
- Retrieval AUC drop ≤ 0.02.
- Effect-norm ratio median in [0.95, 1.05].
- All three frozen sensitivities must avoid material harm and at least two
  must point positive.

## Claim boundary

V15 is operational method development on reused sci-Plex3 data. It is
not causal identification, independent confirmation, wet-lab validation,
or deployment evidence. Feng remains sealed.

## Reference

Kassis, T., Agarwal, V., He, Y., Patel, D., & Brueckner, A. M.
(2026). Scientific Agent Skills: A Library of Procedural Knowledge for
Research Agents. arXiv:2609.00065.
https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2609.00065

SHA-256: 8090005d7c9819fe3d9d19fa7a70c3edfd8dfe946a1e2a63a2243ad17120b92a

# PerturbCompass V15：control-first 低维转导校准方案

## 研究问题

V14 证明了“训练臂 control + 2,000 个逐基因质量模型”会严重放大误差。V15 不再拟合逐基因质量系数，而是检验：**只依靠预测现场可获得的 source/target control，能否在少量低维表达程序上估计一个保守、可退回恒等映射的跨臂校准，并最终改善跨背景扰动预测。**

V15 分成两个严格阶段。Stage A 只允许看 control；Stage B 只有在 Stage A 全部门槛通过、独立审计通过并再次冻结后才允许读取扰动结果。

## 为什么这是与 V14 实质不同的方法

V14 每折用 24 个训练 control 为 2,000 个基因分别估计质量效应，而且不使用预测时可见的目标臂 control。V15 改为：

1. source 和 target 两臂的 control 都可作为转导式输入；
2. 所有映射仅发生在 2/4/8/12 个 control-derived PCA 方向；
3. 每个 arm × context 只估计低维位置和可选的对角尺度；
4. 尺度限制在 0.80–1.25，校准强度限制在 0–1；
5. identity 是正式候选，并由 one-standard-error 规则优先选择；
6. 若 control 内交叉验证没有稳定胜过 identity，V15 当场停止。

## 数据与独立单位

- 输入沿用冻结的 V14 原始 pseudobulk：600 个 culture-plate 单元、2,000 个基因。
- control 共 48 个：2 个 replicate arm × 3 个 cell line × 每格 8 个独立 culture plate。
- Stage A 的独立重复单位是 culture plate，不把单细胞当成独立样本。
- 每个 arm × context 内按 culture plate 数字排序得到 0–7 的固定配对秩；8 折中每折同时留出每个 arm × context 的一个 plate，共 6 个 control。
- 92 个扰动条件在 Stage A 中不可作为拟合、选择或门槛输入。

## 校准器

在每个 Stage-A 内折：

1. 只用其余 42 个 control 估计各 context 的总体均值并残差化；
2. 在残差上拟合 PCA，候选维度为 2、4、8、12；
3. 对每个 arm × context 的 PCA 得分估计均值；`location_scale_diag` 还估计标准差；
4. 把两臂映射到等权共同参考分布；尺度比截断到 [0.80, 1.25]；
5. 以 0.25、0.50、0.75、1.00 的收缩权重把映射与 identity 混合；
6. PCA 正交补空间原样保留。

这不是全矩阵 ComBat，也不是因果批次分解；它只是一个有强边界的低维 control 对齐器。

## Stage A：control-only 选择

主损失是每个留出配对秩、每个 context 的两臂 control 基因平均 MSE，共 8 × 3 = 24 个配对块。候选按平均 MSE 排序，再应用 one-standard-error 规则：在距最佳候选一个标准误以内的模型中，优先 identity，其次更少 PCA 分量、location-only、较小收缩权重。

### 冻结门槛

- G0：输入哈希、600/48/552 结构、2 臂 × 3 context × 8 control 全部正确。
- G1：Stage A 运行时证明只访问 control 行。
- G2：所选候选的 control 跨臂 MSE 至少降低 20%，按 8 个 plate-rank 块 bootstrap 的 95% CI 下界 > 0。
- G3：校正/原始表达范数比中位数在 0.95–1.05，P05 ≥0.90，P95 ≤1.10。
- G4：校正后 control 的 arm probe 平衡准确率 ≤0.60。
- G5：cell-line probe 的下降 ≤0.05，校正后平衡准确率 ≥0.85。
- G6：三个 context 的 control MSE 均不得恶化。
- G7：最终选择不能是 identity；否则说明没有足够校准信号。

只有 G0–G7 全部通过才可写 `READY_FOR_STAGE_B`。

## Stage B：扰动预测

Stage A 通过后，先把所选候选及其三个算法化邻域敏感性版本（较低收缩、较高收缩、相同维数的另一种映射模式）写入第二份冻结清单。随后才允许读取 92 个扰动条件：

- 外层完整留出一个 replicate arm；
- 校准器可使用两臂 control，但不得使用留出臂扰动表达；
- V8 full 在共同低维校准空间训练和预测；
- 预测结果通过目标 arm × context 的逆尺度映射回原始效应空间，再与原始留出真值比较；
- 主比较为 V15 与相同任务上的 raw V8 full；
- 按扰动–剂量–时间条件成簇 bootstrap 2,000 次。

### Stage-B 门槛

- 平均归一化增益至少 +0.0015，95% bootstrap CI 下界 >0；
- 每个 arm 的增益均 ≥-0.002；
- 生物效应跨臂检索 AUC 下降 ≤0.02；
- 校准后/原始效应范数比中位数在 0.95–1.05；
- 三个敏感性版本均不得低于 -0.002，且至少两个为正。

## 解释边界

V15 是在已反复使用的 sci-Plex3 数据上的方法开发，不是独立验证。replicate arm 是自然实验批次而非随机分派的干预组；“生物/测量质量分离”仍是操作性定义。无论结果如何，都不能声称湿实验因果验证、临床或部署有效性。Feng 在另立独立确认协议前继续封存。

## 方法学参考

Kassis, T., Agarwal, V., He, Y., Patel, D., & Brueckner, A. M. (2026). *Scientific Agent Skills: A Library of Procedural Knowledge for Research Agents*. arXiv:2609.00065. https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2609.00065

SHA-256: 9b636b7be0dcf1de33d73080907aba8586fc8b30b526248b5f2ac96dd2b13a57

# V17 source-only safe selection/rejection gate

This is retrospective exploratory development. KOLF and Feng are both development screens; a third untouched screen is required for confirmation.

- Adjudication: `NO_GATE_READY_FOR_EXTERNAL_VALIDATION`
- Primary gate: `logistic_source_only_oof_safety_gate`
- Shared target names: 48

## Cross-screen primary results

| Train -> test | Subset | Coverage | Accepted harm | Change vs always alpha | Eligible row |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| KOLF_to_Feng | all_test_tasks | 0.00% | NA | -2.535% | False |
| KOLF_to_Feng | disjoint_target_names_only | 0.00% | NA | -1.421% | False |
| Feng_to_KOLF | all_test_tasks | 0.00% | NA | -0.696% | False |
| Feng_to_KOLF | disjoint_target_names_only | 0.00% | NA | -0.562% | False |

## Feng split-control stability

- all_test_tasks: q10/median/q90 change versus always alpha = -2.597% / -2.550% / -2.463%.
- disjoint_target_names_only: q10/median/q90 change versus always alpha = -1.475% / -1.431% / -1.358%.

## Claim boundary

No p-values or screen-generalization confidence intervals are reported. Repeated control splits quantify control-partition stability, not independent biological replication. A negative result is not rescued with an unplanned threshold search.

SHA-256: 3559c7305c4a77ff59dbb24cba602b20c1a3136f33431ff2623a3e20b7ee1438

# V17 post-hoc source-only signal diagnostics

These diagnostics were specified after the frozen V17 primary gate failed. They explain the failure and do not change the adjudication.

- Feng_to_KOLF__consensus_quantile_safety_gate: all-task AUROC 0.524, average precision 0.686, score-benefit Spearman 0.258.
- Feng_to_KOLF__logistic_source_only_oof_safety_gate: all-task AUROC 0.535, average precision 0.703, score-benefit Spearman 0.272.
- KOLF_to_Feng__consensus_quantile_safety_gate: all-task AUROC 0.639, average precision 0.898, score-benefit Spearman 0.639.
- KOLF_to_Feng__logistic_source_only_oof_safety_gate: all-task AUROC 0.611, average precision 0.892, score-benefit Spearman 0.111.

## Truth-oracle opportunity upper bound

- Feng: an unavailable truth oracle could improve over always-alpha by only 0.145%.
- KOLF: an unavailable truth oracle could improve over always-alpha by only 0.176%.

The deployable source-only scalar gate is not supported for freezing. Macro-MSE headroom is small and score discrimination is asymmetric across screens.

SHA-256: 35a98cc89bb85a577802ec6104e90c50c23d34419b7900daf27f766a65a78163

# PerturbCompass V20 closeout: control-state biology/quality decomposition

## Outcome

V20 is complete. The frozen exploratory gate did **not** pass.

The tested decomposition defined:

- **Biology:** the screen-wide HCT116 non-targeting-control centroid.
- **Measurement quality:** the target-specific deviation caused by unequal batch composition.
- **Raw control state:** biology plus measurement quality, reconstructed exactly.

Removing the batch-mixture quality component did not rescue the target-control interaction. The current evidence therefore does not support carrying this control-state interaction forward as a confirmatory model.

## Main HCT116 results

| Model | All 530 test tasks: relative MSE change vs global alpha | 101 target-name-disjoint tasks: relative MSE change vs global alpha |
|---|---:|---:|
| Prediction-only | **+0.0750%** | **+0.0553%** |
| Raw interaction | -0.1357% | -0.3850% |
| Biology-only interaction | -0.1434% | -0.4052% |
| Quality-only interaction | -0.00142% | -0.0242% |

Positive values mean lower MSE. The biology-only model was worse than prediction-only in all 10 control-split repeats and worse than the raw interaction in all 10 repeats, in both prespecified subsets.

## What this means

1. The V19 failure is not explained by target-specific HCT116 batch composition alone.
2. The quality-only component is nearly neutral on all tasks, but it does not improve prediction and is negative on the target-name-disjoint subset.
3. Removing that quality component makes the biology-only interaction slightly worse than the raw interaction. The quality term was weakly mitigating, not causing, the main interaction failure.
4. The transferable signal currently resides in source prediction features, not in this formulation of target-control state.
5. KOLF+Feng development OOF improvements were small but positive for all four models (prediction-only +0.0554%, raw +0.0579%, biology-only +0.0559%, quality-only +0.0146%). Their failure on HCT116 is therefore a transferability failure, not simply a fitting failure.

## Reliability checks

- The protocol, code, tests, input files, and decision rule were hashed before the V20 run.
- Models and shrinkage were fitted and selected on KOLF+Feng only.
- HCT116 scoring retained the frozen V19 partition, 32 anchors, 530 tests, and 10 mutually exclusive control splits.
- V20 prediction-only results exactly reproduce the V19 prediction-only baseline.
- V20 raw-interaction results exactly reproduce the V19 interaction baseline.
- All output hashes, formulas, row counts, repeats, and adjudication passed the output audit.
- V19+V20 joint regression tests: 7 passed.

## Claim boundary

V20 is post-V19 exploratory method development because HCT116 outcomes had already been examined. It is not an independent confirmation. The result rejects this specific operational decomposition; it does not prove that every possible biological-signal/measurement-quality method will fail.

Cells, genes, targets, batches, and control splits are not independent screen-level replicates. No p-value or confidence interval is interpreted as screen-level generalization evidence.

## Decision and next step

Stop tuning interaction models on HCT116. For the current paper, retain **prediction-only** as the best externally supported adjustment and report the control-state interaction as a falsified hypothesis.

A further biology/quality separation study should use a genuinely matched bridge design, such as the same perturbations and biological background measured across technical protocols, or the same protocol applied across multiple biological backgrounds. The next model and gates must be frozen before opening that new screen. Without that bridge structure, latent-factor methods can rotate biological and technical variation without making the separation identifiable.

## Reproducible artifacts

- `configs/v20_control_decomposition.yaml`
- `scripts/freeze_v20_control_decomposition.py`
- `scripts/v20_control_decomposition.py`
- `scripts/audit_v20_control_decomposition.py`
- `tests/test_v20_control_decomposition.py`
- `docs/audit/v20_control_decomposition_pre_run_manifest.json`
- `docs/audit/v20_control_decomposition_summary.json`
- `docs/audit/v20_control_decomposition_summary.md`
- `docs/audit/v20_control_decomposition_output_audit.json`
- `data/derived/v20/v20_development_model_selection.csv`
- `data/derived/v20/v20_hct116_repeat_metrics.csv`
- `data/derived/v20/v20_hct116_task_metrics.csv`
- `data/derived/v20/v20_frozen_development_models.npz`

## Methods reference

Kassis, T., Agarwal, V., He, Y., Patel, D., & Brueckner, A. M. (2026). *Scientific Agent Skills: A Library of Procedural Knowledge for Research Agents*. arXiv:2609.00065. https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2609.00065

SHA-256: d2984b6c9971bbdaeb8f99c2dd8c6bf1d5911366ba2cc66c5f21de1ada67ed2f

# V20 control-state biology/quality decomposition

- Adjudication: `BIOLOGY_ONLY_CONTROL_STATE_NOT_READY_FOR_NEW_SCREEN_CONFIRMATION`
- Status: post-V19 exploratory method development; not independent confirmation.

| Subset | Tasks | Biology vs prediction median | q10 | Positive repeats | Biology vs raw median | q10 | Positive repeats | Gate |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| all_test_tasks | 530 | -0.219% | -0.219% | 0.0% | -0.008% | -0.008% | 0.0% | False |
| disjoint_development_target_names_only | 101 | -0.461% | -0.461% | 0.0% | -0.020% | -0.020% | 0.0% | False |

Biology is operationally defined as the screen-wide control centroid. Quality is the target-specific deviation caused by unequal batch composition. The two components exactly reconstruct the original target-control state.

Because HCT116 outcomes were already examined in V19, any positive result is a candidate for a future untouched-screen test, not confirmatory evidence.
